title: Tree forcing, specialization, and forcing axioms
deferred_material: Tree forcing, specialization, and the effect of forcing axioms on Suslin or Aronszajn trees
supporting_development_needed: Develop the specific tree-specialization orders and their forcing-axiom applications. Use internal ccc/cardinal/cofinality preservation, countable-closure preservation of countable ordinal sequences and omega1, and the existing generic-filter/name/ZFC-extension constructions as foundations. State and prove the precise order-specific preservation hypotheses; the elementary tree-existence proof alone supplies no tree-forcing theorem.
